scripts.build: npm run build -w @signalforge/core && npm run build -w @signalforge/engine && npm run build -w @signalforge/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @signalforge/core && npm run test -w @signalforge/engine
scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @signalforge/engine" "npm run dev -w @signalforge/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n engine,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w @signalforge/engine" "npm run start -w @signalforge/web"
